description: This file provides client-side functions for constructing URLs with query parameters and fetching JSON data from a backend API related to NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD). It includes helper functions for URL building and network requests with timeout handling, as well as exported functions to fetch today's APOD and APOD for a specific date.

methods.name: buildUrl(path, params = {})
methods.description: Builds a complete URL with query parameters, normalizing the path and appending parameters.

methods.name: getJson(url, timeoutMs = 15000)
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a given URL with a specified timeout and error handling, including aborting on timeout.

methods.name: fetchApodToday()
methods.description: Fetches the current Astronomy Picture of the Day by calling the backend API at /api/apod.

methods.name: fetchApodByDate(date)
methods.description: Fetches the Astronomy Picture of the Day for a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD) by passing a query parameter to the backend API.
